Axiom: **Every rule activates through an explicit operator decision — never silently.** The decision is two-staged: Stage A locks the relevance shortlist per category with the operator; Stage B walks the axioms of `architecture/*` and `infra/*` rules for Accept (default) / Adapt / Override. Every deviation from a rule default lands in the Decision Log. `coding/*` / `testing/*` rules stay deferred — the phase-subagent loads them at phase entry per `phase-execution-protocol`.
